name: project_traceability_system
description: Professional industrial project traceability and dashboard system for real-time production monitoring.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w client" "npm run start -w backend" "npm run dev -w electron"
scripts.package: npm run build -w client && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path electron/dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force electron/dist }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path electron/dist -Force; Copy-Item -Path client/dist/* -Destination electron/dist -Recurse -Force" && npm run dist -w electron
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install -w client && npm install -w backend && npm install -w electron

author: Meet Mistry
